description: Create a professional one-page medical history summary for a specialist appointment. Open /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/specialist_summary.docx and organize the messy medical information from /home/ga/Documents/medical_notes_raw.txt into a well-formatted document with sections: Current Medications, Chief Complaint, Symptom Timeline, Test Results, Treatments Tried, Allergies, and Family History. Format section headers with bold and larger font. Include specific medications with dosages, timeline dates, and both allergies. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
